name: Koko Yori, Haruka -Surrounded Sea in the World-
original_name: ここより、はるか - Surrounded sea in the world -
source:
"Junki, wake up!" A strange girl shakes Junki awake. "Well, who are you? I'm just sleepy.... What? Where am I?" A place he doesn't remember. A voice he doesn't remember. However he knows this girl who woke him, as Urara, his classmate. She looks at him anxiously flapping her small wings. It seems he fell asleep during class. As he looks around, there is a fairy and a girl carrying a sword. There is nothing wrong even if you see a girl with wings, but he feels somewhat out of place... A place he doesn't remember. A voice he doesn't remember. However he knows it. He is the only one that knows...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
“纯希，快醒醒！”一名陌生的少女轻轻摇醒了纯希。“唔……你是谁？我只是有点犯困……咦？这是哪儿？”陌生的场所，陌生的嗓音；然而他却认得眼前唤醒自己的少女——同班同学丽。少女扑闪着背后小巧的翅膀，满脸担忧地注视着他。看样子，自己似乎在课堂上睡着了。纯希环顾四周，只见教室里有妖精飞舞，还有身佩长剑的女生；在这个世界里，哪怕少女背生双翼也仿佛再正常不过，唯独纯希自己深感格格不入……陌生的场所，陌生的嗓音。然而他心里明白——唯有他一人知晓真相……

[译自ErogeShop]
